target: Fujitsu PRIMERGY RX2540 M7 iRMC S6 02.63S / SDR 03.67
method: A path is counted only when a distinct request constraint reaches a registered handler branch. Parent multiplexers are replaced, not added. The shared 92-record parameter implementation is reused under separate backup and restore wire overlays. F5/07 and F5/0B are replaced by exact length/selector/control partitions. The exact AMIDualImageSupport provider closes its selector-4 and selector-7 wire/effect/completion fragments without importing its other selector behavior. The exact Fujitsu configuration provider closes the eight IPv4 backup overlays; it is not shared with XD670 because that exact image has no libfts_nvram provider.
scope_limits: Static analysis only in this pass; no system was contacted.
Path reachability does not prove backend availability or physical side effects.

Provider-specific parameter validation, redaction, persistence, and secret contents remain unresolved for 165 parameter overlays; eight read-only IPv4 backup overlays are closed through the exact configuration provider.
Only the selector-0x04 and selector-0x07 provider fragments are shared with XD670, based on field-for-field comparison. The different whole-provider binaries are not treated as interchangeable.
LUN-3 FRU identities are retained but prior LAN reachability was negative/unproven.

analysis_boundary_incident.description: A headless Ghidra -process -noanalysis invocation unexpectedly saved the existing zBMC-owned FTSUtil project before use of that project was stopped. No tracked source file changed and no rollback or deletion was attempted.
analysis_boundary_incident.recoverability: Unknown: pre-run hashes or a dedicated backup were not captured, so exact rollback cannot be proven. The three paths are ignored Ghidra project data, not tracked source.
analysis_boundary_incident.tracked_worktree_check: Clean; git status showed only the pre-existing untracked .playwright-mcp/ directory.

configuration_provider.xd670_reuse: none: exact XD670 rootfs has no libfts_nvram provider

field_proof.selector_0x04: request length 1; success returns completion 0x00 plus upload selector 0..3; invalid stored selector -> 0xff
field_proof.selector_0x07: request length 1; success returns completion 0x00 plus one reboot-status byte, including fail-safe watchdog remapping to 6 or 9
field_proof.wrong_length: enabled provider returns 0xc7 before selector-specific work

whole_provider_differences: Selectors 0x08/0x09 handle firmware-info backend status 2 differently.
